# Copilot instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): it is the single source of instructions for this repo.
Start with `playbook/00-start.md`, work one phase at a time with its verification
(`playbook/verification.md`), read `playbook/gotchas.md` first, ask before any action on the TV or on
real devices, and never commit scans, scenes, tokens or device config (`playbook/privacy.md`).
